question: How should the practitioner perform the breath-drinking technique at the tongue and palate?
premises: The practice is located at the root of tongue and palate
The breath is to be taken in
The action must be done slowly
inference: Therefore the practitioner should slowly draw in the breath at the root of the tongue and palate.
plain_english: Placing awareness at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
